name: Amy's Kitchen Gluten-Free Dairy-Free Rice Mac & Cheeze (Vegan Cheeze)
whyItWorks: The ultimate dual-allergy comfort meal: certified gluten-free rice macaroni combined with dairy-free cheddar-style cheeze. Contains zero milk, zero lactose, zero wheat, and minimal fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4–5 minutes until piping hot and bubbly. Stir well before eating.
watchOuts: Safe for individuals with severe primary lactose intolerance or cow's milk protein allergies.
